scenario.name: VLAN authentication failure
scenario.description: 802.1X authentication fails on the New York user VLAN after a RADIUS key change on the access switch.

incident.title: New York users cannot connect wired desktops to the network
incident.description: Wired desktops in New York show 'authentication failed' and get no network access; phones work.

ground_truth.root_cause: The RADIUS shared secret on NYC-SW-01 was changed during maintenance and no longer matches DC1-SRV-AUTH-01; 802.1X on user VLAN 10 fails and ports remain unauthorized.
